Follow [the research workflow](https://github.com/williamzujkowski/williamzujkowski.github.io/blob/main/docs/blog-research.md). Replace prompts with
evidence; mark unknowns explicitly. A proposal does not claim work already ran.

## Reader, question and contribution

Who benefits, what will they understand or do differently, and what is the
provisional thesis? What result would falsify it?

## Verified sources

For each primary source: exact title, authors, URL/DOI, version, submission and
version dates, venue and publication status, relevant section or table, and artifact
revision. Record when the source was read, whether full text was available, and
the outcome of checking for corrections or withdrawals.
Separate the source's finding from our inference and proposed measurements.

## Prior work and distinct angle

Link closest published/draft posts, shelved or withdrawn claims, and open/closed
issues or PRs checked. Explain why this merits a new post rather than an update.
Include external prior art and the strongest counterargument.

## Method, resources and boundaries

Reading/analysis, original experiment, or replication? Describe controls, baseline,
inputs, versions, metrics, denominators, repetitions, raw evidence to retain and
stopping rules. State time/compute/disk/network/API budget and access prerequisites.
Identify owned/synthetic targets, isolation, privileges and artifact license limits.

## Acceptance and review

- [ ] Source identity, version/status and claim ledger verified; limitations stated.
- [ ] Distinct contribution established; strongest objection answered or scoped.
- [ ] Method completed with retained evidence, or unrun work clearly excluded.
- [ ] Accuracy, security/NDA, voice, argument, artifacts and visual QA covered;
      missing or inapplicable checks explicitly recorded.
- [ ] Nexus/reviewer outcomes recorded with actual status and dissent adjudicated.
- [ ] Applicable build/checks pass; publication follows existing authorization.

## Decision and follow-up

Priority and reason; new post / update existing / research needed / shelve.
Name unresolved evidence, feasibility or authorization gaps and the next action.
